lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「凛とした立ち姿の人を尊敬する」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad said he respects people who stand tall and dignified.
lines.style: Warm quoting tone, slowing with quiet respect on Dad's words, tender settled finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「家族の為に尽くされた」事を感謝してるよ
lines.en: Mama, I'm thankful to Daddy for everything he's done for our family.
lines.style: Small serious voice, careful and sincere, quiet warmth swelling on the thanks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが詰将棋の本を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad's reading his book of shogi puzzles again.
lines.style: Soft observational aside, unhurried, a gentle smile at Dad's quiet hobby.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと詰将棋を解く特訓したよ
lines.en: Mama, me and Daddy did special training solving shogi puzzles!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride, quick pace, bouncing emphasis on the special training.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「凛、つまり凛太郎おじいちゃんに敬意を持って」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho-kun, Dad said to show respect to Rin — Grandpa Rintaro, that is.
lines.style: Gentle instructive warmth, careful on the name correction, soft respectful close.
